"""从冻结v66构建两翻译单元阶段诊断，复用已验证计时器，不改生产产物。"""
import argparse
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import runpy
import subprocess
import zipfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4]
DATA = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
PLAN_SHA = "b5df77438c3905566b0a8ddb02b84c2c2f65484facfe26bf559ec2ae085ec44b"
BASE_PATH = DATA / "v47-profile-build.py"
assert hashlib.sha256(BASE_PATH.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == "157f157a6de6f6e5cec8935ccd8977e9e13b7f30f674d4e76701bd1c25aed6b5"
BASE = runpy.run_path(str(BASE_PATH))
sha, require, save = (BASE[key] for key in ("sha", "require", "save"))
split_windows, resolve = (BASE[key] for key in ("split_windows", "resolve"))
file_hashes, require_hashes = (BASE[key] for key in ("file_hashes", "require_hashes"))
compile_arguments, execute, dependency_paths = (BASE[key] for key in ("compile_arguments", "execute", "dependency_paths"))


def read(path):
    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def static_check():
    plan_path = DATA / "v82-plan.json"
    require(sha(plan_path) == PLAN_SHA, "冻结计划变化")
    plan = read(plan_path)
    helper = runpy.run_path(str(DATA / "v82-instrumentation.py"))
    require(list(helper["STAGES"]) == plan["profile_stages"], "阶段集合与计划不符")
    result = helper["static_check"](ROOT)
    require(result["passed"] is True, "当前AAt插桩静态检查未通过")
    return result


def build(output):
    require(output.is_relative_to(ROOT) and not output.exists(), "独立输出须位于工作区且尚不存在")
    plan_path = DATA / "v82-plan.json"
    require(sha(plan_path) == PLAN_SHA, "冻结计划变化")
    plan = read(plan_path)
    require(plan["transformed_units"] == {"ipm": "src/ipm.cpp", "normal": "src/normal_cholesky.cpp"},
            "阶段诊断只能转换两份冻结来源")
    require(plan["primary_linear_solver"] == "normal_cholmod_aat" and
            plan["linear_accuracy"] == "homogeneous_repair", "当前AAt诊断配置变化")
    identity_path = DATA / "ipm-v66-identity.json"
    identity = read(identity_path)
    require(sha(identity_path) == plan["parent_identity_sha256"], "父身份变化")
    archive = DATA / "ipm-v66-source.zip"
    baseline_path = DATA / plan["baseline_identity_file"]
    verification_path = DATA / plan["baseline_verification_file"]
    evidence_path = DATA / plan["evidence_file"]
    require(sha(baseline_path) == plan["baseline_identity_sha256"], "生产基线身份变化")
    require(sha(verification_path) == plan["baseline_verification_sha256"], "起点核对记录变化")
    require(sha(evidence_path) == plan["evidence_sha256"], "前轮证据变化")
    baseline = read(baseline_path)
    production = ROOT / "build/release/solver.exe"
    frozen_parent = ROOT / ".tools/solver-ipm-v66.exe"
    require(sha(archive) == identity["source_zip_sha256"] == plan["parent_source_sha256"], "父源码包变化")
    require(sha(production) == sha(frozen_parent) == baseline["solver_sha256"] ==
            identity["solver_sha256"] == plan["parent_solver_sha256"], "生产与冻结父程序变化")
    require(baseline["files"] == identity["files"] and baseline["libraries"] == identity["libraries"],
            "生产来源和库必须与冻结v66一致")
    require(sha(BASE_PATH) == plan["helper_sha256"], "复用计时工具变化")
    runner_check_path = DATA / "v82-runner-self-check.json"
    runner_check = read(runner_check_path)
    require(runner_check.get("passed") is True and type(runner_check.get("solver_runs")) is int and
            runner_check["solver_runs"] == 0, "运行器纯数据自检尚未通过")
    sources = {str(ROOT / name): value for name, value in baseline["files"].items()}
    libraries = {str(ROOT / name): value for name, value in baseline["libraries"].items()}
    require(len(sources) == 95 and len(libraries) == 17, "生产来源或显式库集合变化")
    require_hashes(sources)
    require_hashes(libraries)
    compiler = Path(identity["compiler"])
    require(sha(compiler) == identity["compiler_sha256"], "编译器变化")
    build_dir = ROOT / "build/release"
    ninja = ROOT / ".tools/ninja-1.13.2/ninja.exe"
    command_text = subprocess.check_output([str(ninja), "-C", str(build_dir), "-t", "commands", "solver.exe"], text=True, encoding="utf-8")
    lines = command_text.splitlines()
    original_compile = {}
    for unit, relative in plan["transformed_units"].items():
        matches = [split_windows(line) for line in lines if " -c " in line and line.replace("\\", "/").endswith("/" + relative)]
        require(len(matches) == 1 and resolve(matches[0][0], build_dir) == compiler, "两翻译单元实际编译命令不唯一")
        original_compile[unit] = matches[0]
    links = [line for line in lines if " -o solver.exe " in line]
    require(links == [identity["link_command"]], "实际链接命令变化")
    outer = split_windows(links[0])
    require(len(outer) == 3 and outer[1].lower() == "/c", "链接包装变化")
    inner = outer[2]
    require(inner.startswith("cd . && ") and inner.endswith(" && cd ."), "链接目录包装变化")
    original_link = split_windows(inner[len("cd . && "):-len(" && cd .")])
    explicit = [resolve(value, build_dir) for value in original_link if not value.startswith("-") and Path(value).suffix.lower() in (".a", ".lib", ".o", ".obj")]
    regularized = build_dir / "CMakeFiles/solver_ipm.dir/src/regularized_ldl.cpp.obj"
    helper_path = DATA / "v82-instrumentation.py"
    protected = file_hashes([production, frozen_parent, compiler, ninja, identity_path, archive, BASE_PATH,
        Path(__file__), helper_path, plan_path, DATA / "v82-run.py", baseline_path, verification_path,
        evidence_path, runner_check_path, regularized, build_dir / "build.ninja", build_dir / "CMakeFiles/rules.ninja", *explicit])
    helper = runpy.run_path(str(helper_path))
    require(list(helper["STAGES"]) == plan["profile_stages"], "阶段集合与计划不符")
    output.mkdir(parents=True)
    frozen = output / "frozen"
    with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as bundle:
        require(len(bundle.namelist()) == 95 and set(bundle.namelist()) == set(identity["files"]),
                "冻结来源包成员变化")
        require(all((frozen / name).resolve().is_relative_to(frozen.resolve()) for name in bundle.namelist()), "源码包路径越界")
        bundle.extractall(frozen)
    frozen_files = {str(frozen / name): value for name, value in identity["files"].items()}
    require_hashes(frozen_files)
    (output / "ninja-commands.txt").write_text(command_text, encoding="utf-8")
    (output / "v47-profile.hpp").write_text(helper["HEADER"], encoding="utf-8")
    static_check = helper["static_check"](frozen)
    require(static_check["passed"] is True, "当前AAt插桩静态检查未通过")
    save(output / "static-check.json", static_check)
    generated_inputs = file_hashes([output / "v47-profile.hpp"])
    transforms, compile_commands, objects = {}, {}, {}
    for unit, relative in plan["transformed_units"].items():
        source = frozen / relative
        transformed, changes = helper["transform"](source.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), unit)
        destination = output / (unit + "-profile.cpp")
        destination.write_text(transformed, encoding="utf-8")
        generated_inputs.update(file_hashes([destination]))
        obj = output / (unit + "-profile.obj")
        objects[unit] = obj
        compile_commands[unit] = compile_arguments(original_compile[unit], destination, obj, frozen, ROOT)
        transforms[unit] = {"source": str(source), "source_sha256": sha(source), "patched": str(destination),
            "patched_sha256": sha(destination), "changes": changes, "reversible": True}
    save(output / "transforms.json", transforms)
    executable = output / "solver-profile.exe"
    link, replaced = [], {"ipm": 0, "normal": 0}
    for value in original_link:
        if value == "libsolver_ipm.a":
            link.extend([str(objects["ipm"]), str(regularized)])
            replaced["ipm"] += 1
        elif value == "libsolver_normal_cholesky.a":
            link.append(str(objects["normal"]))
            replaced["normal"] += 1
        elif not value.startswith("-Wl,--out-implib,"):
            link.append(value)
    require(replaced == {"ipm": 1, "normal": 1}, "两库替换不唯一")
    link[link.index("-o") + 1] = str(executable)
    commands = {"cwd": str(build_dir), "original_compile": original_compile, "original_link": original_link,
        "compile": compile_commands, "link": link}
    save(output / "commands.json", commands)
    environment = {key: value for key, value in os.environ.items()
                   if not key.startswith("SOLVER_V") and key != "OPENBLAS_CORETYPE"}
    environment["PATH"] = str(compiler.parent) + os.pathsep + environment.get("PATH", "")
    compiled_inputs = {}
    for unit, command in compile_commands.items():
        execute(command, build_dir, output / (unit + "-compile.json"), environment)
        compiled_inputs.update(file_hashes(dependency_paths(Path(str(objects[unit]) + ".d"), build_dir)))
    final_inputs = [resolve(value, build_dir) for value in link if not value.startswith("-") and Path(value).suffix.lower() in (".a", ".lib", ".o", ".obj")]
    before = file_hashes(final_inputs)
    execute(link, build_dir, output / "link.json", environment)
    self_commands, self_objects = [], []
    for name, text in (("main", helper["SELF_MAIN"]), ("cross", helper["SELF_CROSS"])):
        source = output / ("self-" + name + ".cpp")
        source.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
        generated_inputs.update(file_hashes([source]))
        obj = output / ("self-" + name + ".obj")
        command = [str(compiler), "-O3", "-DNDEBUG", "-std=c++20", "-Wall", "-Wextra", "-Wpedantic",
            "-DSOLVER_V47_PROFILE_SELFTEST", "-MMD", "-MF", str(obj) + ".d", "-c", str(source), "-o", str(obj)]
        execute(command, build_dir, output / ("self-" + name + "-build.json"), environment)
        compiled_inputs.update(file_hashes(dependency_paths(Path(str(obj) + ".d"), build_dir)))
        self_commands.append(command)
        self_objects.append(str(obj))
    self_executable = output / "profile-self-test.exe"
    self_link = [str(compiler), "-static", *self_objects, "-o", str(self_executable)]
    execute(self_link, build_dir, output / "self-link.json", environment)
    timer_results = {}
    for mode in ("off", "on"):
        env = environment.copy()
        if mode == "on":
            env[plan["profile_environment"]] = plan["profile_enabled_value"]
        row = execute([str(self_executable)], ROOT, output / ("self-" + mode + "-run.json"), env)
        timer_results[mode] = json.loads(row["stdout"])
        require(timer_results[mode] == {"passed": True, "enabled": mode == "on"}, "双翻译单元计时器自测失败")
        require((row["stderr"] == "") if mode == "off" else
                row["stderr"].count(plan["profile_prefix"]) == 1, "计时器开关输出边界错误")
    save(output / "timer-self-check.json", {"passed": True, "solver_runs": 0,
                                            "off": timer_results["off"], "on": timer_results["on"]})
    for values in (protected, sources, libraries, frozen_files, before, generated_inputs, compiled_inputs):
        require_hashes(values)
    outputs = [path for path in output.iterdir() if path.is_file()]
    manifest = {"created_at_utc": datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(), "diagnostic_only": True,
        "production_changes": False,
        "plan_sha256": PLAN_SHA, "production_executable": str(production), "production_sha256": sha(production),
        "frozen_parent_executable": str(frozen_parent), "frozen_parent_sha256": sha(frozen_parent),
        "baseline_identity_file": str(baseline_path), "baseline_identity_sha256": sha(baseline_path),
        "baseline_verification_file": str(verification_path), "baseline_verification_sha256": sha(verification_path),
        "executable": str(executable), "executable_sha256": sha(executable), "self_test_compile": self_commands,
        "self_test_link": self_link, "frozen_files": identity["files"], "protected_before_and_after": protected,
        "current_files": baseline["files"], "actual_libraries": baseline["libraries"],
        "link_explicit_before_and_after": before, "compile_inputs_after_and_final": compiled_inputs,
        "generated_inputs_before_and_after": generated_inputs,
        "implicit_link_inputs_verified": False, "outputs": file_hashes(outputs), "commands": commands,
        "identity_limit": "显式链接输入核前后身份；编译依赖生成后哈希并末尾复核；未逐项核验隐式运行库。"}
    save(output / "build-manifest.json", manifest)
    print(json.dumps({"executable_sha256": manifest["executable_sha256"], "sources": len(sources),
        "libraries": len(libraries), "explicit_link_inputs": len(before), "compile_dependencies": len(compiled_inputs)}), flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, default=ROOT / ".tools/v82-diagnostic")
    parser.add_argument("--self-test", action="store_true", help="仅核计划身份及插桩静态边界，不编译或运行LP")
    arguments = parser.parse_args()
    if arguments.self_test:
        print(json.dumps(static_check(), ensure_ascii=False))
    else:
        build(arguments.output.resolve())

"""v82 阶段诊断：复用锁定的 v47 计时器，区分冻结 v66 的矩形数值路径。"""

import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import types


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4]
DATA = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
HELPER = DATA / "v47-profile-build.py"
PLAN = DATA / "v82-plan.json"
HELPER_SHA256 = "157f157a6de6f6e5cec8935ccd8977e9e13b7f30f674d4e76701bd1c25aed6b5"
# 主代理已冻结的事前计划身份。
PLAN_SHA256 = "b5df77438c3905566b0a8ddb02b84c2c2f65484facfe26bf559ec2ae085ec44b"


def require(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise RuntimeError(message)


def digest(text):
    return hashlib.sha256(text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()


def locked_inputs():
    """旧辅助器和事前计划按原始字节锁定；不产生导入缓存或构建产物。"""
    require(re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", PLAN_SHA256) is not None,
            "v82 计划身份仍为待冻结占位")
    for path, expected in ((HELPER, HELPER_SHA256), (PLAN, PLAN_SHA256)):
        require(hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == expected,
                f"锁定来源身份改变：{path.name}")
    return json.loads(PLAN.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


_plan = locked_inputs()
_legacy = types.ModuleType("solver_v82_locked_v47")
_legacy.__file__ = str(HELPER)
exec(compile(HELPER.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), str(HELPER), "exec"), _legacy.__dict__)

STAGES = _legacy.STAGES + (
    "cone_multiply", "cone_transpose", "cholmod_symbolic", "cholmod_numeric",
    "cholmod_backsolve", "cholmod_values_copy",
    "normal_ordering", "aat_scaling", "cholmod_aat_numeric",
)
require(len(STAGES) == 35 and len(set(STAGES)) == len(STAGES), "阶段容量或名称重复")
require(list(STAGES) == _plan["profile_stages"], "阶段名称和顺序必须符合冻结计划")
require(_plan["profile_environment"] == _legacy.ENVIRONMENT and
        _plan["profile_prefix"] == _legacy.PREFIX, "旧诊断环境变量及输出前缀必须保持")


def replace_once(source, before, after, label):
    require(source.count(before) == 1, f"{label} 锚点不唯一")
    require(before != after, f"{label} 变换不得为空")
    return source.replace(before, after, 1)


_old_names = "inline constexpr const char* names[] = {" + ",".join(
    json.dumps(name) for name in _legacy.STAGES) + "};"
_new_names = "inline constexpr const char* names[] = {" + ",".join(
    json.dumps(name) for name in STAGES) + "};"
_old_capacity = f"inline thread_local std::array<Entry, {len(_legacy.STAGES)}> entries{{}};"
_new_capacity = f"inline thread_local std::array<Entry, {len(STAGES)}> entries{{}};"
HEADER = replace_once(_legacy.HEADER, _old_names, _new_names, "阶段名称")
HEADER = replace_once(HEADER, _old_capacity, _new_capacity, "固定容量")
# 保留旧头文件名、命名空间、环境变量、输出前缀和双翻译单元自测的全部字节。
SELF_MAIN = _legacy.SELF_MAIN
SELF_CROSS = _legacy.SELF_CROSS


def transform(source, unit):
    """沿用旧作用域、表达式物化与可逆记录；每次替换最终都核对唯一字面量。"""
    require(unit in ("ipm", "normal"), "未知翻译单元")
    source = source.replace("\r\n", "\n")
    require("solver_v47_profile::" not in source and
            '#include "v47-profile.hpp"' not in source, "拒绝重复插桩")
    original = source
    changes = []

    def replace(label, before, after):
        nonlocal source
        source = replace_once(source, before, after, f"{unit}/{label}")
        changes.append({"label": label, "before": before, "after": after})

    def scope(label, pattern, stage):
        matches = list(re.finditer(pattern, source))
        require(len(matches) == 1, f"{unit}/{label} 函数锚点数量为 {len(matches)}")
        before = matches[0].group()
        addition = f"\n  solver_v47_profile::Scope v47_scope({STAGES.index(stage)});"
        if stage == "total":
            addition = "\n  solver_v47_profile::Report v47_report;" + addition
        replace(label, before, before + addition)

    def expression(label, expression, stage, value_type=None):
        name = "call" if value_type is None else f"materialize<{value_type}>"
        replace(label, expression,
                f"solver_v47_profile::{name}({STAGES.index(stage)}, [&] {{ return {expression}; }})")

    namespace = "namespace solver {" if unit == "ipm" else "namespace solver::detail {"
    replace("shared_header", namespace, '#include "v47-profile.hpp"\n\n' + namespace)
    if unit == "ipm":
        for label, pattern, stage in (
            ("total", r"SolveResult solve_ipm\([^{}]+\) \{", "total"),
            ("canonicalize", r"ConeModel canonicalize\([^{}]+\) \{", "canonicalize"),
            ("kkt_setup", r"KktFactor\([^{}]+krylov_history_\([^{}]+\) \{", "kkt_setup"),
            ("factor", r"void factor\([^{}]+\) \{", "factor"),
            ("solve", r"std::vector<double> solve\([^{}]+\) const \{", "solve"),
            ("krylov", r"std::vector<double> krylov_refine\([^{}]+\) const \{", "krylov"),
            ("direct", r"std::vector<double> direct\([^{}]+\) const \{", "direct"),
            ("solve_factored", r"void solve_factored\([^{}]+\) const \{", "solve_factored"),
            ("kkt_product", r"void unregularized_residual\([^{}]+\) const \{", "kkt_product"),
            ("assess_homogeneous", r"bool assess_homogeneous\([^{}]+\) \{", "assess_homogeneous"),
            ("assess", r"bool assess\([^{}]+\) \{", "assess"),
            ("homogeneous_direction", r"HomogeneousDirection homogeneous_direction\([^{}]+\) \{", "homogeneous_direction"),
            ("initialize", r"void initialize\([^{}]+\) \{", "initialize"),
            ("run_homogeneous", r"void run_homogeneous_ipm\([^{}]+\) \{", "run_homogeneous"),
            ("cone_multiply", r"void multiply\([^{}]+\) const \{", "cone_multiply"),
            ("cone_transpose", r"void transpose\([^{}]+\) const \{", "cone_transpose"),
        ):
            scope(label, pattern, stage)
        expression("verify_original", "verify_lp_solution(result.model, x, y, options.tolerances, options.pdlp.optimality)", "verify_original")
        # 旧 ordering 仅保留外层 KKT 的 AMD，正规方程的第二次排序另记。
        expression("kkt_ordering", "amd_l_order(static_cast<Index>(factor_dimension_), starts.data(), rows.data(),\n                                      permutation.data(), nullptr, nullptr)", "ordering")
        # 结构回退仍统计适配器，不能把其内部检查时间称作纯数值内核。
        expression("fallback_factor", "multifrontal_ldl_->factor(std::span<const double>(factor_values, ax_.size()),\n            [&options, &start] { check_budget(options, start); })", "fallback_factor_adapter")
        expression("fallback_solve", "multifrontal_ldl_->solve(rhs,\n          [&options, &start] { check_budget(options, start); })", "fallback_solve_adapter")
    else:
        scope("normal_setup", r"Impl\(std::size_t size,[^{}]+max_refinement_steps\(refinement_budget\) \{", "normal_setup")
        scope("normal_factor", r"bool NormalCholesky::factor\([^{}]+\) \{", "normal_factor")
        scope("normal_solve", r"bool NormalCholesky::solve\([^{}]+\) const \{", "normal_solve")
        # 两种内核现在具有同名检查函数；包含各自首行的字面量分别固定边界。
        declaration = "  bool finite_factor(const std::function<void()>& budget_check) const {\n"
        for label, first_line in (
            ("factor_check_eigen", "    // Eigen 的 info() 不保证捕获分解中间产生的 NaN，独立核对存储因子。\n"),
            ("factor_check_cholmod", "    const auto& factor = *resources_.factor;\n"),
        ):
            replace(label, declaration + first_line,
                    declaration + f"    solver_v47_profile::Scope v47_scope({STAGES.index('factor_check')});\n" + first_line)
        expression("normal_ordering", "amd_l_order(retained, matrix.outerIndexPtr(), matrix.innerIndexPtr(), permutation.data(), nullptr, nullptr)", "normal_ordering")
        expression("symbolic_etree", "QDLDL_etree(static_cast<QDLDL_int>(retained), starts.data(), rows.data(), work.data(), counts.data(), tree.data())", "symbolic_analysis")
        expression("symbolic_eigen", "cholesky.analyzePattern(matrix)", "symbolic_analysis")
        expression("symbolic_extended", "extended_cholesky.analyzePattern(extended_matrix)", "symbolic_analysis")
        # 矩形输入先缩放 C，再直接交给 CHOLMOD；它的早返回不得被计作 Gram 装配。
        scaling_pattern = (
            r"      // C=\[G D\^\(-1/2\),sqrt\(R\)\][\s\S]+?"
            r"(?=      check\(budget_check\);\n"
            r"      if \(!state\.cholmod->factor\(std::span<const double>\(state\.rectangular_matrix\.valuePtr\(\),)"
        )
        matches = list(re.finditer(scaling_pattern, source))
        require(len(matches) == 1, "AAt 缩放锚点不唯一")
        body = matches[0].group()
        replace("aat_scaling", body,
                "      {\n        solver_v47_profile::Scope v47_aat_scope(" +
                str(STAGES.index("aat_scaling")) + ");\n" + body + "      }\n")
        pattern = r"  std::fill\(state.sums.begin\(\), state.sums.end\(\), 0\);[\s\S]+?  check\(budget_check\);\n(?=  if \(!state.dual_coordinates.empty\(\)\) \{)"
        matches = list(re.finditer(pattern, source))
        require(len(matches) == 1, "Gram 装配锚点不唯一")
        body = matches[0].group()
        require("state.rectangular" not in body and "state.input_values.assign" not in body,
                "Gram 计时不得包含矩形分支或原输入复制")
        replace("gram_assembly", body,
                "  {\n    solver_v47_profile::Scope v47_gram_scope(" +
                str(STAGES.index("gram_assembly")) + ");\n" + body + "  }\n")
        expression("numeric_double", "state.cholesky.factorize(state.matrix)", "numeric_factor")
        expression("numeric_extended", "state.extended_cholesky.factorize(state.extended_matrix)", "numeric_factor")
        for label, expr, value_type in (
            ("triangular_double", "state.cholesky.solve(permuted)", "Eigen::VectorXd"),
            ("triangular_extended", "state.extended_cholesky.solve(permuted)", "ExtendedVector"),
        ):
            expression(label, expr, "triangular_solve", value_type)
        # 只包同步 C API；调用前后的预算检查、结果校验及恢复留在父作用域。
        # 正常离开计时作用域仍包含库返回失败，不能将 completed 解释为求解成功。
        expression("cholmod_symbolic", "cholmod_l_analyze(&matrix_, &resources_.common)", "cholmod_symbolic")
        numeric_call = "cholmod_l_factorize(input, resources_.factor, &resources_.common)"
        numeric_stage = ("matrix_.stype == 0 ? " + str(STAGES.index("cholmod_aat_numeric")) +
                         " : " + str(STAGES.index("cholmod_numeric")))
        replace("cholmod_numeric", numeric_call,
                "solver_v47_profile::call(" + numeric_stage + ", [&] { return " + numeric_call + "; })")
        expression("cholmod_backsolve", "cholmod_l_solve2(CHOLMOD_A, resources_.factor, &input, nullptr,\n        &resources_.solution, nullptr, &resources_.work, &resources_.extra, &resources_.common)", "cholmod_backsolve")
        copy_body = (
            "      for (std::size_t destination = 0; destination < lower_values_.size(); ++destination) {\n"
            "        if ((destination & 4095) == 0) check(budget_check);\n"
            "        // 仅复制本次已舍入的 double，不缓存跨次分解的矩阵数值。\n"
            "        lower_values_[destination] = values[static_cast<std::size_t>(lower_sources_[destination])];\n"
            "      }\n"
        )
        replace("cholmod_values_copy", copy_body,
                "      {\n        solver_v47_profile::Scope v47_copy_scope(" +
                str(STAGES.index("cholmod_values_copy")) + ");\n" + copy_body + "      }\n")
    rebuilt = source
    for change in reversed(changes):
        rebuilt = replace_once(rebuilt, change["after"], change["before"],
                               f"{unit}/{change['label']} 逆变换")
    require(rebuilt == original, f"{unit} 插桩不可逆")
    return source, changes


def static_check(root):
    """仅验证身份、派生字节和插桩正反例；不编译、不运行 LP，也不写文件。"""
    plan = locked_inputs()
    require(list(STAGES) == plan["profile_stages"], "阶段集合偏离冻结计划")
    restored_header = replace_once(HEADER, _new_capacity, _old_capacity, "头文件容量逆变换")
    restored_header = replace_once(restored_header, _new_names, _old_names, "头文件名称逆变换")
    require(restored_header == _legacy.HEADER, "计时核心不得改变")
    require(SELF_MAIN == _legacy.SELF_MAIN and SELF_CROSS == _legacy.SELF_CROSS,
            "双翻译单元自测不得改变")
    records = {}
    for unit, relative in plan["transformed_units"].items():
        original = (Path(root) / relative).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        patched, changes = transform(original, unit)
        records[unit] = {"anchors": len(changes), "source_text_sha256": digest(original),
                         "instrumented_sha256": digest(patched), "reversible": True}
        for modified in (original.replace("namespace solver", "namespace removed", 1),
                         original + original, patched):
            rejected = False
            try:
                transform(modified, unit)
            except RuntimeError:
                rejected = True
            require(rejected, "必须拒绝缺失、重复锚点及已插桩的输入")

"""第79轮v66全LP阶段诊断：17例五模式轮转，保留失败和完整报告，不优化算法。"""
import argparse
import copy
import datetime
import gzip
import hashlib
import json
import re
import os
from pathlib import Path
import statistics
import subprocess
import sys
import time

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4]
DATA = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
WORK = ROOT / ".tools/v82-diagnostic"
PLAN_SHA = "b5df77438c3905566b0a8ddb02b84c2c2f65484facfe26bf559ec2ae085ec44b"
RAW = DATA / "v82-runs.jsonl.gz"
MANIFEST = DATA / "v82-run-manifest.json"
SUMMARY = DATA / "v82-summary.json"
MODES = ("production", "off", "on1", "on2", "on3")
FIELDS = ("inclusive_ns", "exclusive_ns", "started", "completed", "unwound")
ENVIRONMENT = {name: "1" for name in ("OMP_NUM_THREADS", "OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS", "MKL_NUM_THREADS")}
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "scripts"))
import benchmark
import compare_lp


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def strict_json(value):
    def pairs(items):
        result = {}
        for key, item in items:
            assert key not in result, "JSON对象含重复字段：" + key
            result[key] = item
        return result
    return json.loads(value, object_pairs_hook=pairs, parse_constant=benchmark.invalid_constant,
        parse_float=benchmark.finite_json_float)


def read(path):
    return strict_json(Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def save_new(path, value):
    with path.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as target:
        json.dump(value, target, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
        target.write("\n")


def fixed_plan():
    assert sha(DATA / "v82-plan.json") == PLAN_SHA
    plan = read(DATA / "v82-plan.json")
    assert sha(DATA / "ipm-v66-identity.json") == plan["parent_identity_sha256"]
    assert plan["diagnostic_only"] is True
    assert (plan["round"], plan["version"], plan["parent_version"]) == (79, "v82", 66)
    assert (plan["method"], plan["primary_linear_solver"], plan["linear_accuracy"], plan["objective_scaling"],
        plan["time_limit"], plan["wall_timeout"], plan["threads"], plan["seed"],
        plan["max_iterations"], plan["scaling_passes"]) == (
        "homogeneous", "normal_cholmod_aat", "homogeneous_repair", "off", 5, 35, 1, 0, 200, 5)
    assert plan["modes"] == list(MODES) and type(plan["runs"]) is int and plan["runs"] == 85
    assert len(plan["models"]) == 17 and [item["model_index"] for item in plan["models"]] == list(range(17))
    assert len({item["input"] for item in plan["models"]}) == 17
    assert all(type(item["model_index"]) is int and item["hash_error"] is None and
        re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", item["sha256"]) for item in plan["models"])
    assert (plan["profile_environment"], plan["profile_enabled_value"], plan["profile_prefix"]) == (
        "SOLVER_V47_PROFILE", "1", "V47_PROFILE ")
    assert len(plan["profile_stages"]) == len(set(plan["profile_stages"])) == 35
    assert plan["profile_stages"][-3:] == ["normal_ordering", "aat_scaling", "cholmod_aat_numeric"]
    assert plan["transformed_units"] == {"ipm": "src/ipm.cpp", "normal": "src/normal_cholesky.cpp"}
    assert plan["shared_ipm"] == {"singleton-elimination": "on", "dynamic-regularization": "off",
        "kkt-equilibration": "on", "fixed-variable-elimination": "on", "singleton-presolve": "off",
        "presolve-fixed-elimination": "off", "krylov-history-size": "0", "central-corrections": "0",
        "inexact-prefilter": "off"}
    return plan


def command_for(executable, model, plan):
    command = [str(executable), "solve", model["input"], "--backend", "ipm",
        "--time-limit", str(plan["time_limit"]), "--threads", str(plan["threads"]), "--seed", str(plan["seed"]),
        "--iteration-limit", str(plan["max_iterations"]), "--scaling-passes", str(plan["scaling_passes"]),
        "--ipm-method", plan["method"], "--ipm-linear-accuracy", plan["linear_accuracy"],
        "--ipm-linear-solver", plan["primary_linear_solver"], "--ipm-direction-retries", "0",
        "--ipm-objective-scaling", plan["objective_scaling"]]
    for key, value in plan["shared_ipm"].items():
        command += ["--ipm-" + key, value]
    return command


def valid_process(row):
    expected = {"resolved": 0, "incomplete": 4, "verification_failed": 3}
    if row.get("error") is not None or type(row.get("returncode")) is not int or not isinstance(row.get("report"), dict):
        return False
    actual = benchmark.classify(row["returncode"], row["report"])
    timings = row["report"].get("timings")
    return actual in expected and row.get("classification") == actual and row["returncode"] == expected[actual] and (
        benchmark.finite_real(row.get("elapsed_wall_seconds")) and row["elapsed_wall_seconds"] >= 0 and
        isinstance(timings, dict) and all(benchmark.finite_real(timings.get(name)) and timings[name] >= 0
            for name in ("read_seconds", "solve_seconds", "verification_seconds", "total_seconds")) and
        benchmark.finite_real(row.get("numerical_seconds")) and
        row["numerical_seconds"] == timings["solve_seconds"] + timings["verification_seconds"])


def pair_result(a, b, plan):
    reports = [copy.deepcopy(row["report"]) for row in (a, b)]
    for report in reports:
        if report is not None:
            report.pop("timings", None)
    # JSON序列化保留bool与整数等类型差异；仅排除timings，版本和全部数值字段仍须一致。
    equal = json.dumps(reports[0], sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False) == json.dumps(reports[1], sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False) and (
        a["returncode"] == b["returncode"] and a["error"] == b["error"])
    valid = valid_process(a) and valid_process(b)
    budget = any(row["error"] == "wall_timeout" or (row["report"] or {}).get("status") == "time_limit" or
        row["elapsed_wall_seconds"] > plan["wall_timeout"] or row["numerical_seconds"] is not None and
        row["numerical_seconds"] > plan["time_limit"] for row in (a, b))
    category = "invalid_process" if not valid else "budget_limited" if budget else "equal" if equal else "different"
    return {"equal": equal, "budget_limited": budget, "valid_processes": valid, "category": category}


def parse_profile(stderr, enabled, plan):
    assert isinstance(stderr, str) and type(enabled) is bool
    lines = [line for line in stderr.splitlines() if line.startswith(plan["profile_prefix"])]
    assert len(lines) == int(enabled), "计时报告数量不符"
    if not enabled:
        return None
    payload = strict_json(lines[0][len(plan["profile_prefix"]):])
    assert isinstance(payload, dict) and set(payload) == {"schema", "stages", "clock_reads", "exclusive_sum_ns",
        "total_inclusive_ns", "conserved", "stack_empty", "counts_closed"}
    assert type(payload["schema"]) is int and payload["schema"] == 1
    assert all(payload[key] is True for key in ("conserved", "stack_empty", "counts_closed"))
    stages = payload["stages"]
    assert isinstance(stages, dict) and list(stages) == plan["profile_stages"]
    for stage in stages.values():
        assert set(stage) == {"inclusive_ns", "exclusive_ns", "started", "completed", "unwound"}
        assert all(type(value) is int and 0 <= value < 2**63 for value in stage.values())
        assert stage["started"] == stage["completed"] + stage["unwound"]
        assert stage["exclusive_ns"] <= stage["inclusive_ns"]
        if stage["started"] == 0:
            assert stage["inclusive_ns"] == stage["exclusive_ns"] == 0
    assert stages["total"]["started"] == 1
    assert all(type(payload[key]) is int and 0 <= payload[key] < 2**63 for key in ("clock_reads", "exclusive_sum_ns", "total_inclusive_ns"))
    assert payload["clock_reads"] == 2 * sum(item["started"] for item in stages.values())
    assert sum(item["exclusive_ns"] for item in stages.values()) == stages["total"]["inclusive_ns"]
    assert payload["exclusive_sum_ns"] == payload["total_inclusive_ns"] == stages["total"]["inclusive_ns"]
    return payload


def run_environment(source, enabled, plan):
    # Windows环境名不区分大小写；每次调用重新清除继承开关，避免on污染后续off。
    env = {key: value for key, value in source.items()
        if not key.upper().startswith("SOLVER_V") and key.upper() != "OPENBLAS_CORETYPE"}
    env.update(ENVIRONMENT)
    if enabled:
        env[plan["profile_environment"]] = plan["profile_enabled_value"]
    return env


def validate_timer_run(raw, enabled, work, plan):
    assert raw["command"] == [str(work / "profile-self-test.exe")] and Path(raw["cwd"]) == ROOT
    assert type(raw["returncode"]) is int and raw["returncode"] == 0 and raw["wall_timeout"] is False
    assert isinstance(raw["stdout"], str)
    assert json.dumps(strict_json(raw["stdout"]), sort_keys=True) == json.dumps(
        {"passed": True, "enabled": enabled}, sort_keys=True)
    payload = parse_profile(raw["stderr"], enabled, plan)
    if enabled:
        # 锁定原双翻译单元假时钟：正常返回、异常展开和父子独占账本均已实际覆盖。
        assert payload["clock_reads"] == 12 and payload["total_inclusive_ns"] == 110
        for name, values in (("total", (110, 20, 1, 1, 0)),
            ("canonicalize", (110, 50, 3, 2, 1)), ("normal_setup", (60, 40, 2, 1, 1))):
            assert payload["stages"][name] == dict(zip(FIELDS, values))
        assert all(entry["started"] == 0 for name, entry in payload["stages"].items()
            if name not in ("total", "canonicalize", "normal_setup"))
    else:

def freeze_build(work, plan, build_path, build):
    identity_path = DATA / "ipm-v66-identity.json"
    identity = read(identity_path)
    production, diagnostic = Path(build["production_executable"]), Path(build["executable"])
    parent = ROOT / ".tools/solver-ipm-v66.exe"
    assert production == ROOT / "build/release/solver.exe" and diagnostic == work / "solver-profile.exe"
    assert build["diagnostic_only"] is True and build["production_changes"] is False
    assert build["plan_sha256"] == PLAN_SHA
    assert build["production_sha256"] == identity["solver_sha256"] == plan["parent_solver_sha256"]
    assert Path(build["frozen_parent_executable"]) == parent
    assert build["frozen_parent_sha256"] == identity["solver_sha256"]
    assert build["frozen_files"] == identity["files"]
    assert build["current_files"] == identity["files"] and build["actual_libraries"] == identity["libraries"]
    assert identity["source_zip_sha256"] == plan["parent_source_sha256"]
    assert set(build["commands"]["compile"]) == set(build["commands"]["original_compile"]) == {"ipm", "normal"}
    protected = {}

    def protect(path, expected):
        path = Path(path).resolve()
        assert isinstance(expected, str) and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", expected)
        key = str(path)
        assert key not in protected or protected[key] == expected, "冻结来源哈希冲突：" + key
        assert sha(path) == expected, "冻结来源已变化：" + key
        protected[key] = expected

    for name in ("protected_before_and_after", "link_explicit_before_and_after", "compile_inputs_after_and_final",
        "generated_inputs_before_and_after", "outputs"):
        values = build[name]
        assert isinstance(values, dict) and values
        for path, expected in values.items():
            protect(path, expected)
    for group in ("files", "libraries"):
        for name, expected in identity[group].items():
            protect(ROOT / name, expected)
    for name, expected in identity["files"].items():
        protect(work / "frozen" / name, expected)
    for path, expected in ((Path(__file__), sha(__file__)), (build_path, sha(build_path)),
        (production, build["production_sha256"]), (diagnostic, build["executable_sha256"]),
        (parent, identity["solver_sha256"]), (identity_path, plan["parent_identity_sha256"]),
        (DATA / "ipm-v66-source.zip", identity["source_zip_sha256"])):
        protect(path, expected)
    assert build["protected_before_and_after"][str(Path(__file__).resolve())] == protected[str(Path(__file__).resolve())]
    required = ("v47-profile.hpp", "ipm-profile.cpp", "normal-profile.cpp", "ipm-profile.obj", "normal-profile.obj",
        "static-check.json", "transforms.json", "commands.json", "self-main.cpp", "self-cross.cpp",
        "self-main.obj", "self-cross.obj", "profile-self-test.exe", "self-off-run.json", "self-on-run.json",
        "timer-self-check.json", "solver-profile.exe")
    assert all(str(work / name) in build["outputs"] for name in required)
    # build后编写的独立核验器不参与编译或运行，不能反向成为尚不存在的输入。
    for name in (name for name in plan["new_code_and_plan_files"] if name != "v82-verify.py"):
        path = DATA / name
        assert str(path) in build["protected_before_and_after"]
        protect(path, build["protected_before_and_after"][str(path)])
    for prefix in ("baseline_identity", "baseline_verification"):
        path, expected = DATA / plan[prefix + "_file"], plan[prefix + "_sha256"]
        assert Path(build[prefix + "_file"]) == path and build[prefix + "_sha256"] == expected
        protect(path, expected)
    for name, expected in ((plan["evidence_file"], plan["evidence_sha256"]),
        ("v47-profile-build.py", plan["helper_sha256"])):
        protect(DATA / name, expected)
    for item in plan["local_references"]:
        protect(ROOT / item["file"], item["sha256"])
    for model in plan["models"]:
        protect(model["input"], model["sha256"])
    validate_timer_evidence(work, plan)
    return protected


def summarize_rows(rows, plan):
    assert len(rows) == plan["runs"]
    expected = [(model["model_index"], variant) for model in plan["models"]
        for variant in plan["modes"][model["model_index"] % 5:] + plan["modes"][:model["model_index"] % 5]]
    assert [row["index"] for row in rows] == list(range(plan["runs"]))
    assert [(row["case_index"], row["variant"]) for row in rows] == expected
    pairs, cases = [], []
    for model in plan["models"]:
        group = [row for row in rows if row["case_index"] == model["model_index"]]
        selected = {row["variant"]: row for row in group}
        assert len(group) == len(selected) == len(plan["modes"]) and set(selected) == set(plan["modes"])
        for left, right in (("production", "off"), ("off", "on1"), ("off", "on2"), ("off", "on3")):
            pairs.append({"case_index": model["model_index"], "model": Path(model["input"]).stem,
                "left": left, "right": right, **pair_result(selected[left], selected[right], plan)})
        enabled = [selected[name] for name in ("on1", "on2", "on3")]
        valid_profiles = all(row["profile_error"] is None and row["profile"] is not None for row in enabled)
        medians = {name: {key: statistics.median(row["profile"]["stages"][name][key] for row in enabled)
            for key in ("inclusive_ns", "exclusive_ns", "started", "completed", "unwound")}
            for name in plan["profile_stages"]} if valid_profiles else None
        cases.append({"case_index": model["model_index"], "model": Path(model["input"]).stem,
            "status": {name: (row["report"] or {}).get("status") for name, row in selected.items()},
            "numerical_seconds": {name: row["numerical_seconds"] for name, row in selected.items()},
            "stage_medians": medians})
    return {"diagnostic_only": True, "runs": len(rows), "pairs": pairs, "cases": cases,
        "non_budget_pairs": sum(pair["valid_processes"] and not pair["budget_limited"] for pair in pairs),
        "non_budget_equal": sum(pair["category"] == "equal" for pair in pairs),
        "budget_pairs": sum(pair["category"] == "budget_limited" for pair in pairs),
        "invalid_pairs": sum(pair["category"] == "invalid_process" for pair in pairs),
        "different_pairs": sum(pair["category"] == "different" for pair in pairs),
        "profile_errors": sum(row["profile_error"] is not None for row in rows),
        "scope": "仅诊断成本；阶段中位数分别计算不承诺加总守恒，不作为公开性能或新覆盖。"}

def run(work):
    plan = fixed_plan()

    build_path = work / "build-manifest.json"
    build = read(build_path)
    assert build["plan_sha256"] == PLAN_SHA
    production, diagnostic = Path(build["production_executable"]), Path(build["executable"])
    identities = {str(production): build["production_sha256"], str(diagnostic): build["executable_sha256"]}

    save_new(MANIFEST, {"started_at_utc": datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(), "plan_sha256": PLAN_SHA,
        "build_manifest": str(build_path), "protected": protected, "environment": ENVIRONMENT,
        "removed_environment": "清除所有SOLVER_V开头变量及OPENBLAS_CORETYPE；仅on设置冻结计时开关",
        "work": str(work), "schedule": plan["order"]})
    index = 0
    with gzip.open(RAW, "xt", encoding="utf-8") as target:
        for model in plan["models"]:
            offset = model["model_index"] % len(plan["modes"])
            for variant in plan["modes"][offset:] + plan["modes"][:offset]:
                executable = production if variant == "production" else diagnostic
                enabled = variant.startswith("on")
                command = command_for(executable, model, plan)
                env = run_environment(os.environ, enabled, plan)
                before = {"input": sha(model["input"]), "solver": sha(executable)}
                start, error = time.perf_counter(), None
                try:
                    process = subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, timeout=plan["wall_timeout"], env=env)
                    stdout, stderr, code = process.stdout, process.stderr, process.returncode
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as failure:
                    stdout, stderr, code, error = failure.stdout or b"", failure.stderr or b"", None, "wall_timeout"
                except OSError as failure:
                    stdout, stderr, code, error = b"", str(failure).encode("utf-8"), None, "launch_error"
                elapsed = time.perf_counter() - start
                after = {"input": sha(model["input"]), "solver": sha(executable)}
                stdout, stderr = stdout.decode("utf-8", errors="replace"), stderr.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
                try:
                    report = strict_json(stdout)
                    if not isinstance(report, dict):
                        report, error = None, error or "invalid_report"
                except (AssertionError, ValueError, TypeError):
                    report, error = None, error or "invalid_json"
                profile, profile_error = None, None
                try:
                    profile = parse_profile(stderr, enabled, plan)
                except (AssertionError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError) as failure:
                    profile_error = type(failure).__name__ + ": " + str(failure)
                row = {"index": index, "case_index": model["model_index"], "input": model["input"], "model": Path(model["input"]).stem,
                    "variant": variant, "command": command, "returncode": code, "report": report, "stdout": stdout,
                    "stderr": stderr, "error": error, "elapsed_wall_seconds": elapsed, "hashes_before": before,
                    "hashes_after": after, "model_sha256": before["input"], "profile": profile, "profile_error": profile_error,
                    "classification": benchmark.classify(code, report) if report is not None else error}
                numerical = compare_lp.numerical_seconds(row)
                failure = compare_lp.quality_failure(row, model, after["input"], identities[str(executable)], after["solver"])
                if failure is None and (numerical > plan["time_limit"] or elapsed > plan["wall_timeout"]):
                    failure = "budget_exceeded"
                row.update(numerical_seconds=numerical, quality_pass=failure is None, quality_failure=failure)
                target.write(json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
                target.flush()
                assert before == after and before["input"] == model["sha256"] and before["solver"] == identities[str(executable)]
                print(json.dumps({"index": index, "model": row["model"], "variant": variant,
                    "status": (report or {}).get("status"), "profile_error": profile_error, "valid_process": valid_process(row)}), flush=True)
                index += 1
    for path, expected in protected.items():
        assert sha(path) == expected
    summarize()
